servicesSummary: Khalifa Haftar The registrant's relationship with the principal, Khalifa Haftar, was terminated as of September 30, 2021. During the registration, the Registrant issued two statements to US media regarding the registrant's limited mission in supporting the principal's support of free and fair, UN-supervised elections on December 23 to facilitate a peaceful, stable, unified, democratic Libya, under the rule of law.
